verdict.rationale: Decagon's security page says its agents use short-lived JWT tokens scoped for minimal privilege and discarded after each session. That is a first-party least-privilege credential mechanism for agents accessing customer systems. However, there is no documentation of how a user issues or configures these credentials or defines their scopes, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented user-facing credential issuance flow, configurable scope/permission definitions, rotation/revocation controls, API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Short-lived JWT tokens give AI agents real-time access to customer systems, scoped for minimal privilege and discarded after each session.
